blocks.text: Kim Chiu is over the moon after her film with rumored boyfriend Paulo Avelino made it to the official lineup of the 2026 Metro Manila Film Festival (MMFF), saying her heart is “full of gratitude.” Though the actress-host was not present during the unveiling of the second batch of movie entries that made the MMFF “Magic 8,” she took to social media to express her thanks for the inclusion of their family drama. “Yung kaba ko, GRABE!!! Naiyak talaga ako nung in-announce ni Ms. Laurice Guillen ang family drama category! My heart is so full of gratitude! Maraming, maraming salamat po […]...
